data_description.api_key: Your Foreca Weather API key from the My API page

user.description: Create a free account at developer.foreca.com to get an API key.

data_description.location: The location to get the weather forecast for

get_15_minute_forecast.description: Retrieves the forecast in 15-minute steps for the next three hours, in the weather entity's units. Every call makes a request to the Foreca Weather API and counts toward the daily limit of your plan.
get_15_minute_forecast.name: Get 15-minute forecast

get_forecasts_extra.description: Retrieves the forecast values that weather.get_forecasts has no place for, such as precipitation type, snow, solar radiation, sunshine and sunrise. They come from the forecast already fetched, so the action makes no API requests.

type.description: The forecast to return the values for.
type.name: Forecast type

get_forecasts_extra.name: Get extra forecast values

get_minute_forecast.description: Retrieves the precipitation rate for each minute of the next hour, in the weather entity's precipitation unit per hour. Every call makes a request to the Foreca Weather API and counts toward the daily limit of your plan.
get_minute_forecast.name: Get minute forecast
